question.text: In Young's double slit experiment, if the source of light changes from orange to blue then:

options.text: the central bright fringe will become a dark fringe.
the distance between consecutive fringes will decrease.
the distance between consecutive fringes will increase.
the intensity of the minima will increase.

solution.text:
Fringe width =λDd.
As λ decreases, fringe width also decreases.
